name: AWS Lambda
description: Invoke Lambda functions and manage configuration, versions, aliases, concurrency, policies, layers and tags with signed AWS API requests.

permissions.description: Signed HTTPS requests only to region-specific AWS Lambda API. Optional sessionTokenSecret and alternate credential references require corresponding host secret authorization. Exact confirmation for external actions; no automatic retries.

definitions.name: Lambda List Functions (Direct)
definitions.description: Lambda List Functions
definitions.documentation:
Lambda List Functions. GET /2015-03-31/functions. Exactly one signed HTTPS request, no client/workflow retries or hidden polling. Invocation Event means accepted into AWS queue, not executed; AWS may retry or duplicate asynchronous events. RequestResponse returns bytes/base64 and function-error independently of HTTP status. Single page only; follow NextMarker deliberately. Update acceptance is not resource readiness; read State/LastUpdateStatus or provisioned Status. PUT async config replaces settings and removes omitted settings; POST updates selected settings. DeleteFunction without Qualifier deletes every version and alias. GetFunction excludes code download URLs and environment variables. GetLayerVersion excludes download URLs. Selected known fields only; optional absence/falsy values preserved; undocumented null rejected. 512 KiB request/invoke response and 1 MiB management response; 50 items/page; timeout 15 s default, 60 s max plus independently bounded 250 ms cleanup. Node builtin crypto only, no dependency installation. Source: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/api/API_ListFunctions.html

definitions.name: Lambda Get Function (Direct)
definitions.description: Lambda Get Function
definitions.documentation:
Lambda Get Function. GET /2015-03-31/functions/{FunctionName}. Exactly one signed HTTPS request, no client/workflow retries or hidden polling. Invocation Event means accepted into AWS queue, not executed; AWS may retry or duplicate asynchronous events. RequestResponse returns bytes/base64 and function-error independently of HTTP status. Single page only; follow NextMarker deliberately. Update acceptance is not resource readiness; read State/LastUpdateStatus or provisioned Status. PUT async config replaces settings and removes omitted settings; POST updates selected settings. DeleteFunction without Qualifier deletes every version and alias. GetFunction excludes code download URLs and environment variables. GetLayerVersion excludes download URLs. Selected known fields only; optional absence/falsy values preserved; undocumented null rejected. 512 KiB request/invoke response and 1 MiB management response; 50 items/page; timeout 15 s default, 60 s max plus independently bounded 250 ms cleanup. Node builtin crypto only, no dependency installation. Source: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/api/API_GetFunction.html

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: Lambda Get Configuration and Status (Direct)
definitions.description: Lambda Get Configuration and Status
definitions.documentation:
Lambda Get Configuration and Status. GET /2015-03-31/functions/{FunctionName}/configuration. Exactly one signed HTTPS request, no client/workflow retries or hidden polling. Invocation Event means accepted into AWS queue, not executed; AWS may retry or duplicate asynchronous events. RequestResponse returns bytes/base64 and function-error independently of HTTP status. Single page only; follow NextMarker deliberately. Update acceptance is not resource readiness; read State/LastUpdateStatus or provisioned Status. PUT async config replaces settings and removes omitted settings; POST updates selected settings. DeleteFunction without Qualifier deletes every version and alias. GetFunction excludes code download URLs and environment variables. GetLayerVersion excludes download URLs. Selected known fields only; optional absence/falsy values preserved; undocumented null rejected. 512 KiB request/invoke response and 1 MiB management response; 50 items/page; timeout 15 s default, 60 s max plus independently bounded 250 ms cleanup. Node builtin crypto only, no dependency installation. Source: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/api/API_GetFunctionConfiguration.html

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.description: Lambda Update Configuration
definitions.documentation:
Lambda Update Configuration. PUT /2015-03-31/functions/{FunctionName}/configuration. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation=CONFIGURATION_UPDATE. External action may commit before timeout; reconcile before rerunning. Exactly one signed HTTPS request, no client/workflow retries or hidden polling. Invocation Event means accepted into AWS queue, not executed; AWS may retry or duplicate asynchronous events. RequestResponse returns bytes/base64 and function-error independently of HTTP status. Single page only; follow NextMarker deliberately. Update acceptance is not resource readiness; read State/LastUpdateStatus or provisioned Status. PUT async config replaces settings and removes omitted settings; POST updates selected settings. DeleteFunction without Qualifier deletes every version and alias. GetFunction excludes code download URLs and environment variables. GetLayerVersion excludes download URLs. Selected known fields only; optional absence/falsy values preserved; undocumented null rejected. 512 KiB request/invoke response and 1 MiB management response; 50 items/page; timeout 15 s default, 60 s max plus independently bounded 250 ms cleanup. Node builtin crypto only, no dependency installation. Source: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/api/API_UpdateFunctionConfiguration.html

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: Lambda Update Code from S3 (Direct)
definitions.description: Lambda Update Code from S3
definitions.documentation:
Lambda Update Code from S3. PUT /2015-03-31/functions/{FunctionName}/code. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation=CODE_UPDATE_S3. External action may commit before timeout; reconcile before rerunning. Exactly one signed HTTPS request, no client/workflow retries or hidden polling. Invocation Event means accepted into AWS queue, not executed; AWS may retry or duplicate asynchronous events. RequestResponse returns bytes/base64 and function-error independently of HTTP status. Single page only; follow NextMarker deliberately. Update acceptance is not resource readiness; read State/LastUpdateStatus or provisioned Status. PUT async config replaces settings and removes omitted settings; POST updates selected settings. DeleteFunction without Qualifier deletes every version and alias. GetFunction excludes code download URLs and environment variables. GetLayerVersion excludes download URLs. Selected known fields only; optional absence/falsy values preserved; undocumented null rejected. 512 KiB request/invoke response and 1 MiB management response; 50 items/page; timeout 15 s default, 60 s max plus independently bounded 250 ms cleanup. Node builtin crypto only, no dependency installation. Source: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/api/API_UpdateFunctionCode.html

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.documentation:
Lambda Create Function from S3. POST /2015-03-31/functions. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation=FUNCTION_CREATE_S3. External action may commit before timeout; reconcile before rerunning. Exactly one signed HTTPS request, no client/workflow retries or hidden polling. Invocation Event means accepted into AWS queue, not executed; AWS may retry or duplicate asynchronous events. RequestResponse returns bytes/base64 and function-error independently of HTTP status. Single page only; follow NextMarker deliberately. Update acceptance is not resource readiness; read State/LastUpdateStatus or provisioned Status. PUT async config replaces settings and removes omitted settings; POST updates selected settings. DeleteFunction without Qualifier deletes every version and alias. GetFunction excludes code download URLs and environment variables. GetLayerVersion excludes download URLs. Selected known fields only; optional absence/falsy values preserved; undocumented null rejected. 512 KiB request/invoke response and 1 MiB management response; 50 items/page; timeout 15 s default, 60 s max plus independently bounded 250 ms cleanup. Node builtin crypto only, no dependency installation. Source: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/api/API_CreateFunction.html

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.description: Lambda Update Code from Image
definitions.documentation:
Lambda Update Code from Image. PUT /2015-03-31/functions/{FunctionName}/code. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation=CODE_UPDATE_IMAGE. External action may commit before timeout; reconcile before rerunning. Exactly one signed HTTPS request, no client/workflow retries or hidden polling. Invocation Event means accepted into AWS queue, not executed; AWS may retry or duplicate asynchronous events. RequestResponse returns bytes/base64 and function-error independently of HTTP status. Single page only; follow NextMarker deliberately. Update acceptance is not resource readiness; read State/LastUpdateStatus or provisioned Status. PUT async config replaces settings and removes omitted settings; POST updates selected settings. DeleteFunction without Qualifier deletes every version and alias. GetFunction excludes code download URLs and environment variables. GetLayerVersion excludes download URLs. Selected known fields only; optional absence/falsy values preserved; undocumented null rejected. 512 KiB request/invoke response and 1 MiB management response; 50 items/page; timeout 15 s default, 60 s max plus independently bounded 250 ms cleanup. Node builtin crypto only, no dependency installation. Source: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/api/API_UpdateFunctionCode.html

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.documentation:
Lambda Create Function from Image. POST /2015-03-31/functions. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation=FUNCTION_CREATE_IMAGE. External action may commit before timeout; reconcile before rerunning. Exactly one signed HTTPS request, no client/workflow retries or hidden polling. Invocation Event means accepted into AWS queue, not executed; AWS may retry or duplicate asynchronous events. RequestResponse returns bytes/base64 and function-error independently of HTTP status. Single page only; follow NextMarker deliberately. Update acceptance is not resource readiness; read State/LastUpdateStatus or provisioned Status. PUT async config replaces settings and removes omitted settings; POST updates selected settings. DeleteFunction without Qualifier deletes every version and alias. GetFunction excludes code download URLs and environment variables. GetLayerVersion excludes download URLs. Selected known fields only; optional absence/falsy values preserved; undocumented null rejected. 512 KiB request/invoke response and 1 MiB management response; 50 items/page; timeout 15 s default, 60 s max plus independently bounded 250 ms cleanup. Node builtin crypto only, no dependency installation. Source: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/api/API_CreateFunction.html

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.description: Lambda Delete Function
definitions.documentation:
Lambda Delete Function. DELETE /2015-03-31/functions/{FunctionName}. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation=FUNCTION_DELETE. External action may commit before timeout; reconcile before rerunning. Exactly one signed HTTPS request, no client/workflow retries or hidden polling. Invocation Event means accepted into AWS queue, not executed; AWS may retry or duplicate asynchronous events. RequestResponse returns bytes/base64 and function-error independently of HTTP status. Single page only; follow NextMarker deliberately. Update acceptance is not resource readiness; read State/LastUpdateStatus or provisioned Status. PUT async config replaces settings and removes omitted settings; POST updates selected settings. DeleteFunction without Qualifier deletes every version and alias. GetFunction excludes code download URLs and environment variables. GetLayerVersion excludes download URLs. Selected known fields only; optional absence/falsy values preserved; undocumented null rejected. 512 KiB request/invoke response and 1 MiB management response; 50 items/page; timeout 15 s default, 60 s max plus independently bounded 250 ms cleanup. Node builtin crypto only, no dependency installation. Source: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/api/API_DeleteFunction.html

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: Lambda Invoke Synchronously (Direct)
definitions.description: Lambda Invoke Synchronously
definitions.documentation:
Lambda Invoke Synchronously. POST /2015-03-31/functions/{FunctionName}/invocations. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation=INVOKE_SYNC. External action may commit before timeout; reconcile before rerunning. Exactly one signed HTTPS request, no client/workflow retries or hidden polling. Invocation Event means accepted into AWS queue, not executed; AWS may retry or duplicate asynchronous events. RequestResponse returns bytes/base64 and function-error independently of HTTP status. Single page only; follow NextMarker deliberately. Update acceptance is not resource readiness; read State/LastUpdateStatus or provisioned Status. PUT async config replaces settings and removes omitted settings; POST updates selected settings. DeleteFunction without Qualifier deletes every version and alias. GetFunction excludes code download URLs and environment variables. GetLayerVersion excludes download URLs. Selected known fields only; optional absence/falsy values preserved; undocumented null rejected. 512 KiB request/invoke response and 1 MiB management response; 50 items/page; timeout 15 s default, 60 s max plus independently bounded 250 ms cleanup. Node builtin crypto only, no dependency installation. Source: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/api/API_Invoke.html

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: Lambda Invoke Asynchronously (Direct)
definitions.description: Lambda Invoke Asynchronously
definitions.documentation:
Lambda Invoke Asynchronously. POST /2015-03-31/functions/{FunctionName}/invocations. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation=INVOKE_ASYNC. External action may commit before timeout; reconcile before rerunning. Exactly one signed HTTPS request, no client/workflow retries or hidden polling. Invocation Event means accepted into AWS queue, not executed; AWS may retry or duplicate asynchronous events. RequestResponse returns bytes/base64 and function-error independently of HTTP status. Single page only; follow NextMarker deliberately. Update acceptance is not resource readiness; read State/LastUpdateStatus or provisioned Status. PUT async config replaces settings and removes omitted settings; POST updates selected settings. DeleteFunction without Qualifier deletes every version and alias. GetFunction excludes code download URLs and environment variables. GetLayerVersion excludes download URLs. Selected known fields only; optional absence/falsy values preserved; undocumented null rejected. 512 KiB request/invoke response and 1 MiB management response; 50 items/page; timeout 15 s default, 60 s max plus independently bounded 250 ms cleanup. Node builtin crypto only, no dependency installation. Source: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/api/API_Invoke.html

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: Lambda Validate Invocation (Direct)
definitions.description: Lambda Validate Invocation
definitions.documentation:
Lambda Validate Invocation. POST /2015-03-31/functions/{FunctionName}/invocations. Exactly one signed HTTPS request, no client/workflow retries or hidden polling. Invocation Event means accepted into AWS queue, not executed; AWS may retry or duplicate asynchronous events. RequestResponse returns bytes/base64 and function-error independently of HTTP status. Single page only; follow NextMarker deliberately. Update acceptance is not resource readiness; read State/LastUpdateStatus or provisioned Status. PUT async config replaces settings and removes omitted settings; POST updates selected settings. DeleteFunction without Qualifier deletes every version and alias. GetFunction excludes code download URLs and environment variables. GetLayerVersion excludes download URLs. Selected known fields only; optional absence/falsy values preserved; undocumented null rejected. 512 KiB request/invoke response and 1 MiB management response; 50 items/page; timeout 15 s default, 60 s max plus independently bounded 250 ms cleanup. Node builtin crypto only, no dependency installation. Source: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/api/API_Invoke.html

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: Lambda List Versions (Direct)
definitions.description: Lambda List Versions
definitions.documentation:
Lambda List Versions. GET /2015-03-31/functions/{FunctionName}/versions. Exactly one signed HTTPS request, no client/workflow retries or hidden polling. Invocation Event means accepted into AWS queue, not executed; AWS may retry or duplicate asynchronous events. RequestResponse returns bytes/base64 and function-error independently of HTTP status. Single page only; follow NextMarker deliberately. Update acceptance is not resource readiness; read State/LastUpdateStatus or provisioned Status. PUT async config replaces settings and removes omitted settings; POST updates selected settings. DeleteFunction without Qualifier deletes every version and alias. GetFunction excludes code download URLs and environment variables. GetLayerVersion excludes download URLs. Selected known fields only; optional absence/falsy values preserved; undocumented null rejected. 512 KiB request/invoke response and 1 MiB management response; 50 items/page; timeout 15 s default, 60 s max plus independently bounded 250 ms cleanup. Node builtin crypto only, no dependency installation. Source: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/api/API_ListVersionsByFunction.html

definitions.description: Lambda Publish Version
definitions.documentation:
Lambda Publish Version. POST /2015-03-31/functions/{FunctionName}/versions. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation=VERSION_PUBLISH. External action may commit before timeout; reconcile before rerunning. Exactly one signed HTTPS request, no client/workflow retries or hidden polling. Invocation Event means accepted into AWS queue, not executed; AWS may retry or duplicate asynchronous events. RequestResponse returns bytes/base64 and function-error independently of HTTP status. Single page only; follow NextMarker deliberately. Update acceptance is not resource readiness; read State/LastUpdateStatus or provisioned Status. PUT async config replaces settings and removes omitted settings; POST updates selected settings. DeleteFunction without Qualifier deletes every version and alias. GetFunction excludes code download URLs and environment variables. GetLayerVersion excludes download URLs. Selected known fields only; optional absence/falsy values preserved; undocumented null rejected. 512 KiB request/invoke response and 1 MiB management response; 50 items/page; timeout 15 s default, 60 s max plus independently bounded 250 ms cleanup. Node builtin crypto only, no dependency installation. Source: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/api/API_PublishVersion.html

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: Lambda List Aliases (Direct)
definitions.description: Lambda List Aliases
definitions.documentation:
Lambda List Aliases. GET /2015-03-31/functions/{FunctionName}/aliases. Exactly one signed HTTPS request, no client/workflow retries or hidden polling. Invocation Event means accepted into AWS queue, not executed; AWS may retry or duplicate asynchronous events. RequestResponse returns bytes/base64 and function-error independently of HTTP status. Single page only; follow NextMarker deliberately. Update acceptance is not resource readiness; read State/LastUpdateStatus or provisioned Status. PUT async config replaces settings and removes omitted settings; POST updates selected settings. DeleteFunction without Qualifier deletes every version and alias. GetFunction excludes code download URLs and environment variables. GetLayerVersion excludes download URLs. Selected known fields only; optional absence/falsy values preserved; undocumented null rejected. 512 KiB request/invoke response and 1 MiB management response; 50 items/page; timeout 15 s default, 60 s max plus independently bounded 250 ms cleanup. Node builtin crypto only, no dependency installation. Source: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/api/API_ListAliases.html

definitions.description: Lambda Update Alias
definitions.documentation:
Lambda Update Alias. PUT /2015-03-31/functions/{FunctionName}/aliases/{Name}. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation=ALIAS_UPDATE. External action may commit before timeout; reconcile before rerunning. Exactly one signed HTTPS request, no client/workflow retries or hidden polling. Invocation Event means accepted into AWS queue, not executed; AWS may retry or duplicate asynchronous events. RequestResponse returns bytes/base64 and function-error independently of HTTP status. Single page only; follow NextMarker deliberately. Update acceptance is not resource readiness; read State/LastUpdateStatus or provisioned Status. PUT async config replaces settings and removes omitted settings; POST updates selected settings. DeleteFunction without Qualifier deletes every version and alias. GetFunction excludes code download URLs and environment variables. GetLayerVersion excludes download URLs. Selected known fields only; optional absence/falsy values preserved; undocumented null rejected. 512 KiB request/invoke response and 1 MiB management response; 50 items/page; timeout 15 s default, 60 s max plus independently bounded 250 ms cleanup. Node builtin crypto only, no dependency installation. Source: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/api/API_UpdateAlias.html

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.documentation:
Lambda Delete Alias. DELETE /2015-03-31/functions/{FunctionName}/aliases/{Name}. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation=ALIAS_DELETE. External action may commit before timeout; reconcile before rerunning. Exactly one signed HTTPS request, no client/workflow retries or hidden polling. Invocation Event means accepted into AWS queue, not executed; AWS may retry or duplicate asynchronous events. RequestResponse returns bytes/base64 and function-error independently of HTTP status. Single page only; follow NextMarker deliberately. Update acceptance is not resource readiness; read State/LastUpdateStatus or provisioned Status. PUT async config replaces settings and removes omitted settings; POST updates selected settings. DeleteFunction without Qualifier deletes every version and alias. GetFunction excludes code download URLs and environment variables. GetLayerVersion excludes download URLs. Selected known fields only; optional absence/falsy values preserved; undocumented null rejected. 512 KiB request/invoke response and 1 MiB management response; 50 items/page; timeout 15 s default, 60 s max plus independently bounded 250 ms cleanup. Node builtin crypto only, no dependency installation. Source: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/api/API_DeleteAlias.html

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.documentation:
Lambda Get Function Event Invoke Config. GET /2019-09-25/functions/{FunctionName}/event-invoke-config. Exactly one signed HTTPS request, no client/workflow retries or hidden polling. Invocation Event means accepted into AWS queue, not executed; AWS may retry or duplicate asynchronous events. RequestResponse returns bytes/base64 and function-error independently of HTTP status. Single page only; follow NextMarker deliberately. Update acceptance is not resource readiness; read State/LastUpdateStatus or provisioned Status. PUT async config replaces settings and removes omitted settings; POST updates selected settings. DeleteFunction without Qualifier deletes every version and alias. GetFunction excludes code download URLs and environment variables. GetLayerVersion excludes download URLs. Selected known fields only; optional absence/falsy values preserved; undocumented null rejected. 512 KiB request/invoke response and 1 MiB management response; 50 items/page; timeout 15 s default, 60 s max plus independently bounded 250 ms cleanup. Node builtin crypto only, no dependency installation. Source: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/api/API_GetFunctionEventInvokeConfig.html

definitions.documentation:
Lambda Put Function Event Invoke Config. PUT /2019-09-25/functions/{FunctionName}/event-invoke-config. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation=ASYNC_CONFIG_PUT. External action may commit before timeout; reconcile before rerunning. Exactly one signed HTTPS request, no client/workflow retries or hidden polling. Invocation Event means accepted into AWS queue, not executed; AWS may retry or duplicate asynchronous events. RequestResponse returns bytes/base64 and function-error independently of HTTP status. Single page only; follow NextMarker deliberately. Update acceptance is not resource readiness; read State/LastUpdateStatus or provisioned Status. PUT async config replaces settings and removes omitted settings; POST updates selected settings. DeleteFunction without Qualifier deletes every version and alias. GetFunction excludes code download URLs and environment variables. GetLayerVersion excludes download URLs. Selected known fields only; optional absence/falsy values preserved; undocumented null rejected. 512 KiB request/invoke response and 1 MiB management response; 50 items/page; timeout 15 s default, 60 s max plus independently bounded 250 ms cleanup. Node builtin crypto only, no dependency installation. Source: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/api/API_PutFunctionEventInvokeConfig.html

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.documentation:
Lambda Update Function Event Invoke Config. POST /2019-09-25/functions/{FunctionName}/event-invoke-config. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation=ASYNC_CONFIG_UPDATE. External action may commit before timeout; reconcile before rerunning. Exactly one signed HTTPS request, no client/workflow retries or hidden polling. Invocation Event means accepted into AWS queue, not executed; AWS may retry or duplicate asynchronous events. RequestResponse returns bytes/base64 and function-error independently of HTTP status. Single page only; follow NextMarker deliberately. Update acceptance is not resource readiness; read State/LastUpdateStatus or provisioned Status. PUT async config replaces settings and removes omitted settings; POST updates selected settings. DeleteFunction without Qualifier deletes every version and alias. GetFunction excludes code download URLs and environment variables. GetLayerVersion excludes download URLs. Selected known fields only; optional absence/falsy values preserved; undocumented null rejected. 512 KiB request/invoke response and 1 MiB management response; 50 items/page; timeout 15 s default, 60 s max plus independently bounded 250 ms cleanup. Node builtin crypto only, no dependency installation. Source: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/api/API_UpdateFunctionEventInvokeConfig.html

definitions.documentation:
Lambda Delete Function Event Invoke Config. DELETE /2019-09-25/functions/{FunctionName}/event-invoke-config. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation=ASYNC_CONFIG_DELETE. External action may commit before timeout; reconcile before rerunning. Exactly one signed HTTPS request, no client/workflow retries or hidden polling. Invocation Event means accepted into AWS queue, not executed; AWS may retry or duplicate asynchronous events. RequestResponse returns bytes/base64 and function-error independently of HTTP status. Single page only; follow NextMarker deliberately. Update acceptance is not resource readiness; read State/LastUpdateStatus or provisioned Status. PUT async config replaces settings and removes omitted settings; POST updates selected settings. DeleteFunction without Qualifier deletes every version and alias. GetFunction excludes code download URLs and environment variables. GetLayerVersion excludes download URLs. Selected known fields only; optional absence/falsy values preserved; undocumented null rejected. 512 KiB request/invoke response and 1 MiB management response; 50 items/page; timeout 15 s default, 60 s max plus independently bounded 250 ms cleanup. Node builtin crypto only, no dependency installation. Source: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/api/API_DeleteFunctionEventInvokeConfig.html

definitions.name: Lambda Get Reserved Concurrency (Direct)
definitions.description: Lambda Get Reserved Concurrency
definitions.documentation:
Lambda Get Reserved Concurrency. GET /2019-09-30/functions/{FunctionName}/concurrency. Exactly one signed HTTPS request, no client/workflow retries or hidden polling. Invocation Event means accepted into AWS queue, not executed; AWS may retry or duplicate asynchronous events. RequestResponse returns bytes/base64 and function-error independently of HTTP status. Single page only; follow NextMarker deliberately. Update acceptance is not resource readiness; read State/LastUpdateStatus or provisioned Status. PUT async config replaces settings and removes omitted settings; POST updates selected settings. DeleteFunction without Qualifier deletes every version and alias. GetFunction excludes code download URLs and environment variables. GetLayerVersion excludes download URLs. Selected known fields only; optional absence/falsy values preserved; undocumented null rejected. 512 KiB request/invoke response and 1 MiB management response; 50 items/page; timeout 15 s default, 60 s max plus independently bounded 250 ms cleanup. Node builtin crypto only, no dependency installation. Source: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/api/API_GetFunctionConcurrency.html

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.documentation:
Lambda Set Reserved Concurrency. PUT /2017-10-31/functions/{FunctionName}/concurrency. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation=CONCURRENCY_PUT. External action may commit before timeout; reconcile before rerunning. Exactly one signed HTTPS request, no client/workflow retries or hidden polling. Invocation Event means accepted into AWS queue, not executed; AWS may retry or duplicate asynchronous events. RequestResponse returns bytes/base64 and function-error independently of HTTP status. Single page only; follow NextMarker deliberately. Update acceptance is not resource readiness; read State/LastUpdateStatus or provisioned Status. PUT async config replaces settings and removes omitted settings; POST updates selected settings. DeleteFunction without Qualifier deletes every version and alias. GetFunction excludes code download URLs and environment variables. GetLayerVersion excludes download URLs. Selected known fields only; optional absence/falsy values preserved; undocumented null rejected. 512 KiB request/invoke response and 1 MiB management response; 50 items/page; timeout 15 s default, 60 s max plus independently bounded 250 ms cleanup. Node builtin crypto only, no dependency installation. Source: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/api/API_PutFunctionConcurrency.html

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.documentation:
Lambda Set Provisioned Concurrency. PUT /2019-09-30/functions/{FunctionName}/provisioned-concurrency. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation=PROVISIONED_PUT. External action may commit before timeout; reconcile before rerunning. Exactly one signed HTTPS request, no client/workflow retries or hidden polling. Invocation Event means accepted into AWS queue, not executed; AWS may retry or duplicate asynchronous events. RequestResponse returns bytes/base64 and function-error independently of HTTP status. Single page only; follow NextMarker deliberately. Update acceptance is not resource readiness; read State/LastUpdateStatus or provisioned Status. PUT async config replaces settings and removes omitted settings; POST updates selected settings. DeleteFunction without Qualifier deletes every version and alias. GetFunction excludes code download URLs and environment variables. GetLayerVersion excludes download URLs. Selected known fields only; optional absence/falsy values preserved; undocumented null rejected. 512 KiB request/invoke response and 1 MiB management response; 50 items/page; timeout 15 s default, 60 s max plus independently bounded 250 ms cleanup. Node builtin crypto only, no dependency installation. Source: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/api/API_PutProvisionedConcurrencyConfig.html

definitions.documentation:
Lambda Delete Provisioned Concurrency. DELETE /2019-09-30/functions/{FunctionName}/provisioned-concurrency. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation=PROVISIONED_DELETE. External action may commit before timeout; reconcile before rerunning. Exactly one signed HTTPS request, no client/workflow retries or hidden polling. Invocation Event means accepted into AWS queue, not executed; AWS may retry or duplicate asynchronous events. RequestResponse returns bytes/base64 and function-error independently of HTTP status. Single page only; follow NextMarker deliberately. Update acceptance is not resource readiness; read State/LastUpdateStatus or provisioned Status. PUT async config replaces settings and removes omitted settings; POST updates selected settings. DeleteFunction without Qualifier deletes every version and alias. GetFunction excludes code download URLs and environment variables. GetLayerVersion excludes download URLs. Selected known fields only; optional absence/falsy values preserved; undocumented null rejected. 512 KiB request/invoke response and 1 MiB management response; 50 items/page; timeout 15 s default, 60 s max plus independently bounded 250 ms cleanup. Node builtin crypto only, no dependency installation. Source: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/api/API_DeleteProvisionedConcurrencyConfig.html

definitions.documentation:
Lambda List Provisioned Concurrency. GET /2019-09-30/functions/{FunctionName}/provisioned-concurrency. Exactly one signed HTTPS request, no client/workflow retries or hidden polling. Invocation Event means accepted into AWS queue, not executed; AWS may retry or duplicate asynchronous events. RequestResponse returns bytes/base64 and function-error independently of HTTP status. Single page only; follow NextMarker deliberately. Update acceptance is not resource readiness; read State/LastUpdateStatus or provisioned Status. PUT async config replaces settings and removes omitted settings; POST updates selected settings. DeleteFunction without Qualifier deletes every version and alias. GetFunction excludes code download URLs and environment variables. GetLayerVersion excludes download URLs. Selected known fields only; optional absence/falsy values preserved; undocumented null rejected. 512 KiB request/invoke response and 1 MiB management response; 50 items/page; timeout 15 s default, 60 s max plus independently bounded 250 ms cleanup. Node builtin crypto only, no dependency installation. Source: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/api/API_ListProvisionedConcurrencyConfigs.html

Selected known fields only; optional absence/falsy values preserved; undocumented null rejected. 512 KiB request/invoke response and 1 MiB management response; 50 items/page; timeout 15 s default, 60 s max plus independently bounded 250 ms cleanup. Node builtin crypto only, no dependency installation. Source: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/api/API_AddPermission.html

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.documentation:
Lambda Remove Permission. DELETE /2015-03-31/functions/{FunctionName}/policy/{StatementId}. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation=PERMISSION_REMOVE. External action may commit before timeout; reconcile before rerunning. Exactly one signed HTTPS request, no client/workflow retries or hidden polling. Invocation Event means accepted into AWS queue, not executed; AWS may retry or duplicate asynchronous events. RequestResponse returns bytes/base64 and function-error independently of HTTP status. Single page only; follow NextMarker deliberately. Update acceptance is not resource readiness; read State/LastUpdateStatus or provisioned Status. PUT async config replaces settings and removes omitted settings; POST updates selected settings. DeleteFunction without Qualifier deletes every version and alias. GetFunction excludes code download URLs and environment variables. GetLayerVersion excludes download URLs. Selected known fields only; optional absence/falsy values preserved; undocumented null rejected. 512 KiB request/invoke response and 1 MiB management response; 50 items/page; timeout 15 s default, 60 s max plus independently bounded 250 ms cleanup. Node builtin crypto only, no dependency installation. Source: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/api/API_RemovePermission.html

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.description: Lambda Get Layer Version
definitions.documentation:
Lambda Get Layer Version. GET /2018-10-31/layers/{LayerName}/versions/{VersionNumber}. Exactly one signed HTTPS request, no client/workflow retries or hidden polling. Invocation Event means accepted into AWS queue, not executed; AWS may retry or duplicate asynchronous events. RequestResponse returns bytes/base64 and function-error independently of HTTP status. Single page only; follow NextMarker deliberately. Update acceptance is not resource readiness; read State/LastUpdateStatus or provisioned Status. PUT async config replaces settings and removes omitted settings; POST updates selected settings. DeleteFunction without Qualifier deletes every version and alias. GetFunction excludes code download URLs and environment variables. GetLayerVersion excludes download URLs. Selected known fields only; optional absence/falsy values preserved; undocumented null rejected. 512 KiB request/invoke response and 1 MiB management response; 50 items/page; timeout 15 s default, 60 s max plus independently bounded 250 ms cleanup. Node builtin crypto only, no dependency installation. Source: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/api/API_GetLayerVersion.html

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.documentation:
Lambda Delete Layer Version. DELETE /2018-10-31/layers/{LayerName}/versions/{VersionNumber}. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation=LAYER_VERSION_DELETE. External action may commit before timeout; reconcile before rerunning. Exactly one signed HTTPS request, no client/workflow retries or hidden polling. Invocation Event means accepted into AWS queue, not executed; AWS may retry or duplicate asynchronous events. RequestResponse returns bytes/base64 and function-error independently of HTTP status. Single page only; follow NextMarker deliberately. Update acceptance is not resource readiness; read State/LastUpdateStatus or provisioned Status. PUT async config replaces settings and removes omitted settings; POST updates selected settings. DeleteFunction without Qualifier deletes every version and alias. GetFunction excludes code download URLs and environment variables. GetLayerVersion excludes download URLs. Selected known fields only; optional absence/falsy values preserved; undocumented null rejected. 512 KiB request/invoke response and 1 MiB management response; 50 items/page; timeout 15 s default, 60 s max plus independently bounded 250 ms cleanup. Node builtin crypto only, no dependency installation. Source: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/api/API_DeleteLayerVersion.html

definitions.description: Lambda List Tags
definitions.documentation:
Lambda List Tags. GET /2017-03-31/tags/{Resource}. Exactly one signed HTTPS request, no client/workflow retries or hidden polling. Invocation Event means accepted into AWS queue, not executed; AWS may retry or duplicate asynchronous events. RequestResponse returns bytes/base64 and function-error independently of HTTP status. Single page only; follow NextMarker deliberately. Update acceptance is not resource readiness; read State/LastUpdateStatus or provisioned Status. PUT async config replaces settings and removes omitted settings; POST updates selected settings. DeleteFunction without Qualifier deletes every version and alias. GetFunction excludes code download URLs and environment variables. GetLayerVersion excludes download URLs. Selected known fields only; optional absence/falsy values preserved; undocumented null rejected. 512 KiB request/invoke response and 1 MiB management response; 50 items/page; timeout 15 s default, 60 s max plus independently bounded 250 ms cleanup. Node builtin crypto only, no dependency installation. Source: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/api/API_ListTags.html

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.documentation:
Lambda Add or Replace Tags. POST /2017-03-31/tags/{Resource}. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation=TAGS_PUT. External action may commit before timeout; reconcile before rerunning. Exactly one signed HTTPS request, no client/workflow retries or hidden polling. Invocation Event means accepted into AWS queue, not executed; AWS may retry or duplicate asynchronous events. RequestResponse returns bytes/base64 and function-error independently of HTTP status. Single page only; follow NextMarker deliberately. Update acceptance is not resource readiness; read State/LastUpdateStatus or provisioned Status. PUT async config replaces settings and removes omitted settings; POST updates selected settings. DeleteFunction without Qualifier deletes every version and alias. GetFunction excludes code download URLs and environment variables. GetLayerVersion excludes download URLs. Selected known fields only; optional absence/falsy values preserved; undocumented null rejected. 512 KiB request/invoke response and 1 MiB management response; 50 items/page; timeout 15 s default, 60 s max plus independently bounded 250 ms cleanup. Node builtin crypto only, no dependency installation. Source: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/api/API_TagResource.html
